definitions.gloss: to hit; to bump into; to run into (an obstacle)
definitions.explanation: To physically collide with something or reach an obstruction.

definitions.gloss: to come to a dead end; to reach the end of a road
definitions.explanation: To arrive at a point where one cannot proceed further.

definitions.gloss: to encounter; to face (a problem or difficulty)
definitions.explanation: To come up against an abstract obstacle like a problem or challenge.

examples.english: If you go straight down the road, you'll hit a wall.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧)
- Pattern: X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}き{当|あ}たる

FORMS:
Compound verb: ⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧ (to thrust/poke) + ⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ (to hit)

- {突|つ}き{当|あ}たる → {突|つ}き⟦{当|あ}たらない→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ (negative)
- {突|つ}き{当|あ}たる → {突|つ}き⟦{当|あ}たって→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ (te-form)
- {突|つ}き{当|あ}たる → {突|つ}き⟦{当|あ}たった→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ (past)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}き{当|あ}たる - to hit a wall (literal/figurative)
- ⟦{行|い}き{止|ど}まり→行き止まり：08167_ikidomari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}き{当|あ}たる - to reach a dead end
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}き{当|あ}たる - to encounter a problem

DIRECTIONS:
Commonly used when giving directions: 「⟦{突|つ}き{当|あ}たり→突き当たり：08399_tsukiatari⟧」 means "at the end of the road."
